- `DatasetSpec v0.1` requires every time axis to name an observed raw variable; it cannot encode an index-derived clock.
- Each signal carries one scalar `dtype`, although the profile already correctly exposes a set of observed dtypes.

- `ValidationIssue` has no severity, and repair orchestration always returns the latest candidate; that alone explains the 12 → 2 → 5 regression.

The minimal v0.2 design I’ll implement is: add `implicit_regular` axes with nullable raw source, index origin, and an evidence-bearing rate claim; add `observed_dtypes` while retaining v0.1 decoding; validate documented rates only against actual contradictory observations; and score candidates deterministically as valid first, then fewer issues, retaining the earlier candidate on ties. The prompt change will be schema-only and generic—no Bosch vocabulary or hints.
